title: EthosGPT: Mapping Human Value Diversity to Advance Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to simulate average citizens from 126 cultural entities and answering World Values Survey questions, then comparing the resulting LLM-generated cultural indices (Traditional vs. Secular-Rational and Survival vs. Self-Expression) against empirical human survey data using Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE).

Using geoprompting to cast the LLM as a resident of specific countries and evaluating the discrepancy in representation and value alignment between the model's outputs and actual national survey responses.
